name: Fixes reach prod
ownerWords: 이런 느낌으로 푸쉬해줘. 모든 쓰레드에서 user intent를 분석하고, 꾸준히 발생했던 문제는 duties로 묶어야 돼.
goal: Every fix that lands on staging reaches prod within 24 h. Prod is auto-sns-agent main, which promote.yml moves only after every prod deploy and check passes, so a commit on staging and not on main has not fully reached prod even when the prod crawler already runs it. Under owner rule c154 (2026-10-22) a job's work ends at staging, and every prod promote is a walk with the owner that only the release owner (session 01a10810) dispatches, except the crawler, observability dashboards and demo.virev.ai. So this duty keeps the gates in front of that walk green, which are the land into staging, the staging deploy of staging's head and the promote itself, and tells the release owner what waits once they are. The problem kept coming back in this chat: promotes 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13 and 14 each failed at a gate, 18 lands named a failure between 10-08 and 10-19, on 10-19 seven board steps waited a day or more for one promote while land 37 sat on staging from 10-17 22:58Z, and from 10-23 00:41Z every land failed at basics while the staging deploy of staging's head 6e71eb0478 had failed, which the precheck missed because 53 of the newest 60 land runs were cancelled. Each run names the oldest waiting commit, the newest decided land of each branch, the newest successful land and staging head's age, the newest decided staging deploy and the newest staging sha whose staging deploy passed, the newest decided promote, each failed run's job and step, and where the staging and prod crawlers' /health versions sit. The 8 in commits_on_staging_only is the busiest UTC day of staging lands from 10-01 to 10-19 (8 lands on 10-19), so more than that waiting means at least a day of lands missed prod.

onMiss: Read the gate flags first. A red gate is a land_failed run, a staging_deploy_failed run of staging's head, or a promote_failed run. Each red gate gets exactly one fix job, with a board step under p96 whose text starts "d4/<metric key>:" and names that gate's run id, job, step and hours from the flag. When a live job of any chat already owns that gate (await agent_observe.list_agents()), send it the run id, job, step and hours by message and set the step's job to it; else start one with await rlm.create_session(brief, name=..., cwd=...) and set the step's job to it, never a second copy. The fix is shipped code that makes that gate pass on its own (the check, the deploy config or the test it names), landed on staging through land.yml. A promote_in_flight or staging_deploy_in_flight flag means that run is going: set board.wake(run=<id>) and read its result after the wake instead of starting a job for the same gate. When every gate is green and a metric still misses, the wait is the owner's release walk (c154): message the release owner (session 01a10810) with the sha from staging_deploy_passed, the oldest_fix commit and the hours it waited, and start no code job. A source_error is fixed in this precheck first. Never dispatch, rerun or cancel a land.yml, staging-deploy.yml or promote.yml run, and touch no prod state. Nothing goes outside (c37). All on target: end the turn with no message.
